A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same RealDGen paper with all 18 pages, including Appendix A.1–A.7 and references. Text, equations, tables, and figures support complete comparison; only the first-page arXiv stamp and file metadata differ.

before.justification: Section 3 reports original super-resolution and data-generation experiments, ablations, and a 10-volunteer user study. Appendix A.5–A.6 includes fine-tuning and filtering experiments.

after.justification: Section 3 and Appendix A.5–A.6 retain the same original benchmark results, ablations, user study, and supplementary experiments.

M1.justification: Section 2, Algorithms 1–2, and the appendix retain identical content/degradation extractors, training losses, decoupled diffusion, fine-tuning, and filtering procedures.

E1.justification: Both use the same DIV2K content data and real-LR training corpus, with unchanged RealSR, DRealSR, SmartPhone, and out-of-distribution RealVSR evaluations.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged, including Real-ESRGAN, BSRGAN, and SynDiff in Tables 1, 2, and 5, and the VQVAE comparison in Figure 6.

E3.justification: Training and evaluation settings, SR backbones, metrics, and sample sizes are identical. Both retain the 200-image RealVSR evaluation and user study involving 10 images and 10 volunteers.

E4.justification: The denoising-step and extractor ablations in Tables 3–4, RealVSR generalization test, and fine-tuning and filtering analyses in Appendix A.5–A.6 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical, including the user-score distributions in Figure 5. No repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests are added or removed.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results match, including Tables 1–7 and appendix comparisons. For example, Table 5 reports RealDGen PSNR 22.9616 and SSIM 0.6994 on RealVSR in both versions.

T1.justification: Equations 1–8 and the mathematical expressions in both algorithms are identical. No formal assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about unsupervised, adaptive generation of realistic paired data and improved super-resolution generalization.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and limitations are unchanged, including diffusion stochasticity, difficulty preserving tiny textures, and proposed future adaptive denoising-step selection.

D1.justification: Section 3.1 and the appendix provide identical architecture, hyperparameter, data-processing, hardware, and training-time details. The BasicSR access information is also unchanged.

R1.justification: All 66 references and the positioning relative to manual collection, hand-crafted degradation, and learning-based generation methods remain identical.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv margin stamp changes from v1, 11 Jun 2024 to v3, 21 Oct 2024. The paper's wording, title, authors, and section structure are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–10, Tables 1–7, captions, and page layout are unchanged. Pages 2–18 render identically, and first-page visual differences are confined to the version/date stamp.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, empirical evidence, appendix material, explanations, and visual presentation are unchanged. Updating the arXiv stamp and file metadata provides no meaningful improvement or deterioration in paper quality.
